payload.text: The spot-vs-forward delta switch is a one-year tenor threshold (docs/CONVENTIONS.md DeltaConvention: short tenors quote spot delta, long tenors switch to forward/driftless delta). `is_long_tenor(tenor)` is a pure total predicate returning tenor_days(tenor) > 365 — STRICTLY greater, so exactly-one-year tenors (Tenor::Years(1) and Tenor::Months(12), both 365 days) classify as SHORT (spot delta) and 18M / 2Y classify as LONG (forward delta), exactly as long_tenor_threshold_is_one_year pins. This boolean is the `forward` axis fed to premium_adjusted_of in region_default. const-foldable, no writes/allocation/IO; deterministic. Self-invalidates if the threshold or tenor_days mapping changes (WRITES gate).
